name: Disable shorts URLs
desc: Make any YouTube shorts URL redirect back to the YouTube homepage.

name: Hide shorts
desc: Completely hide the YouTube Shorts section from your video feed.

name: Hide sponsored content
desc: Hide any sponsored content in the video feed. Not needed if you are using a dedicated ad blocker.

name: Hide paid content
desc: Hides any content that requires payment to access, like movies, from the feed.

name: Hide comments
desc: Automatically hide the comment section on long form videos.

name: Hide watch-next
desc: Hide the watch-next section next to or below videos.

name: Hide post video suggestions
desc: Hides the video suggestions showing up inside the video player after a video finishes.
